caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical ceramic container with a conical lid that ends in a rounded knob at the top. The container is a light beige color with blue decorations. Near the upper third of the container, there is a horizontal band, and above it, the lid features a blue elliptical vertical slot outlined in blue paint. The body of the container has decorative blue floral or scroll-like designs. The base and rim both have subtle blue accent lines. The background is a plain off-white or light tan color, and there is a small signature reading “N. Amantea” on the lower right side.
title: Money Bank
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
